In current LevelDB (master, post-2019 `env_posix.cc` cleanup), `kReadOnlyFileLimit` no longer exists — the read-only file-descriptor limiter was removed (the table cache/`Options::max_open_files` bounds open files now), leaving only `kDefaultMmapLimit = 1000`. Historically, before its removal, the constant was defined as `kReadOnlyFileLimit = 25`.

ANSWER: does not exist in current leveldb (removed in 2019; its former value was 25)
